svg.title: Observations versus error with mean-shift density peaks
svg.desc: Each point is a localisation run. The horizontal axis shows observations used and the vertical axis shows error in kilometres on a logarithmic scale. Mean shift discovers local density peaks and marks sparse points as noise. Crosshairs show the original seed locations for reference.

g.title: low error initial seed reference: 10 observations, 8.00 km
medium error initial seed reference: 25 observations, 200.0 km
high error initial seed reference: 8 observations, 5,000 km
